first_comment: To test if they were truly asleep, the team woke the spiders with a loud sound. In REM-like sleep, some didn't respond at all. Would you watch a sleeping spider? 🕷️

stories.headline: A jumping spider sleeps in 2 stages, one with twitches
stories.summary: Filming Portia fimbriata over many nights, a University of Bonn team saw a still, droopy phase, then a REM-like stage with leg curls and eye flickers while hanging upside down.
stories.why: An expert called it the most complete case for sleep in any spider, hinting sleep is very ancient.

stories.stat_label: suns' worth of gas, but no starlight
stories.headline: 2 radio telescopes found a possible galaxy with no stars
stories.summary: China's FAST and the old Arecibo dish both detected AGC 322753: a rotating cloud with about 2 billion suns' worth of hydrogen, yet deep images show no matching glow.
stories.why: If it holds no stars, it could be a rare 'dark galaxy', a long-sought kind of object.

stories.stat_label: years old, in a fingertip of amber
stories.headline: A 99-million-year-old lizard tail proves an escape trick
stories.summary: An 18 mm piece of amber holds a lizard tail with a clean break and a ring of muscle, the same set-up modern lizards use to drop their tails and flee predators.
stories.why: It is the best direct fossil proof yet that lizards shed tails in the age of dinosaurs.

stories.headline: She caught a tip-jar thief, then gave him a croissant
stories.summary: Café worker Luciana Gabriela Acevedo saw a man take her tips and made him give them back. Then she called him over and handed him a pastry instead of calling the police.
stories.why: The security video went viral, and she said empathy for others is a value she learned young.

fun_fact: Portia jumping spiders hunt other spiders, and an adult is only about 10 mm long.
